evidenceAssessment.notice: Incomplete birthdate evidence for eligible drivers. Sporting affiliations are represented, including neutral RAF without a national flag; unresolved birthdates can still change these age records.
evidenceAssessment.missingEvidence: Identity-bound complete birthdates for the excluded eligible drivers; credible biographies or documented corrections are acceptable evidence.

coverage.note: Ages use accepted birthdate evidence plus explicit owner editorial selections for disputed dates. The owner selections are not independently verified, unanimous, or official; competing source dates are retained in stats-owner-dob-decisions-20260917.json. No eligible date is replaced by zero. Nationality is the sporting nationality documented for that season or event; event-specific evidence takes precedence. No current-biography or adjacent-season extrapolation. Neutral (RAF) is a sporting affiliation without a national flag; RAF preserves the original designation.
